<notes>
kept -> base -> inv1 and dom1 both used identical unmodified harness and produced "120, 1" with correct reasoning; base1 produced "60, 1" but analysis shows base1's code had bugs (incorrect timezone handling in Amelia's interval bounds: sets 17:00 instead of 16:00 as end). Neither candidate proposed harness changes (both showed "no change"), meaning both found the unmodified harness sufficient. Single incorrect rollout in 1/1 base set is noise per mission rules; no pattern to fix. Candidates agree on correct answer (120, 1) with clear verification: Tuesday 14:00-16:00 is only slot fitting 120 min with all constraints. Harness enables solution; no edit required.
</notes>
